§6Cleanup Systems§f

§aPollution builds fast. You need chimneys and filters before your base becomes a death trap.§f

Your machines pump out gas clouds constantly. Without ventilation, carbon and sulfur will pool inside your base and start killing you. Two systems handle this: §9chimneys§f for passive venting and §9Filter blocks§f for active purification.

§6Chimneys & Vents§f: Place chimneys from §9Advanced Chimneys§f on top of fuel-burning blocks. They vent smoke straight up to altitude 127, preventing carbon buildup in your workrooms. Different styles (Cobblestone, Brick, Bedrock) are purely cosmetic.

§6Filter Block§f: The real workhorse. This block purifies air and water in a configurable radius. Drop a filter material into the GUI slot, power it, and make sure a chimney or open sky is above it. The filter consumes material and produces useful byproducts:
§b- Tree Leaves§f: filters §eCarbon§f, yields §bCoal Dust§f
§b- Wool§f (any color): filters §eSulfur§f, yields §bSulfur Dust§f
§b- Paper§f: filters §eDust§f, yields §bClay Balls§f

§ePS:§f The filter also cleans polluted water in a radius around it. Place it near any tainted water sources.
